subject: Re: Redwood Hosted API — Quickstart & deployment options
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Hosted API — Quickstart & deployment options

Hi Lina—

Thanks again for the demo earlier — really appreciated you and Tom taking the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps as you evaluate the Hosted API vs Dedicated/Private:

Recap from our call:
- Primary goal: proof-of-concept to embed product recommendations and a short-form assistant in your storefront.
- Traffic profile discussed: expected 80–200 concurrent users during peak; estimate ~15M tokens/month for initial evaluation.
- Compliance note: you mentioned HIPAA concerns for a subset of telemetry and preference for US data residency.

Hosted API quickstart (recommended to get running in < 24 hrs):
1) Create an API key in the Console (Team > API keys).
2) Use the generation endpoint: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
   - Example curl:
     curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
       -H "Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>" \
       -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
       -d '{"model":"redwood-alpha-1","input":"Your prompt here","max_tokens":256}'
3) For chat flows use https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat (streaming supported).

Rate limits & quotas (hosted):
- Default rate limit: 60 requests/min per API key; default token throughput: 300,000 tokens/min.
- We can lift these for evaluation to 300 requests/min and higher token throughput for short-term tests — just tell me the target.
- If you need production-level sustained QPS, Dedicated or Reserved capacity is recommended (see below).

Security & data residency:
- Hosted is SOC 2 compliant; data is encrypted at rest and in transit.
- You can pin region to us-east or eu-west via the Console for residency.
- For workloads with strict network controls or on-prem requirements we offer Private (VPC or on-prem).

Differences at a glance:
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, shared multi-tenant infra, configurable region, good for initial eval and many production apps.
- Dedicated: isolated GPU pools, SLA-backed latency/uptime, commit-based pricing; good for predictable throughput and strict performance needs.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full network isolation, customer-controlled KMS/HSM, audit logs — for regulated environments.

Attachments: redwood_quickstart_guide.pdf (walkthrough + sample apps).

Next steps I suggest:
- If you want a quick Hosted eval, tell me approximate target rate (req/min & tokens/min) and I can temporarily raise limits.
- If you want to explore Dedicated/Private, I’ll schedule a short infra deep-dive with Marissa (solutions engineering) and pull a SOW excerpt.
- Please share the security questionnaire (if you have one) and I’ll have Neha coordinate the answers.

Would you be able to run a quick smoke test this week? I can bump your rate to 300 req/min for 72 hours to validate latency at scale.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Hi Lina — great questions. Short answers and operational next steps below.

Data & training use: Hosted customers can opt out of model training data retention; we will not use your inputs for model training if you select the "no-training" flag in the Console. We also have a standard Data Processing Addendum (DPA) we can sign — Neha, I’ve attached the questionnaire and can route the DPA.

Temporary rate increase: I can raise your Hosted API limits to 300 req/min and 600k tokens/min for a 72-hour window today. Confirm the API key you want us to bump (or we can create a test key).

Region & residency: We can pin your team to us-east for the evaluation; that guarantees storage in the US.

Dedicated ballpark (high level):
- Lead time: 2–4 weeks after contract and onboarding depending on capacity.
- Throughput: predictable sustained QPS with reserved GPU pools.
- Pricing: typical entry tier starts at a monthly commit (we can share a tailored SOW once we understand target throughput).

Next operational steps (proposed):
1) Confirm you want the 72-hour run at 300 req/min (yes/no + API key to bump).
2) If yes, I’ll raise limits and send a test key + sample load script.
3) Marissa — can you take Lina and Tom for a 30-min infra call this week to review Dedicated sizing and Private/VPC options?
4) Neha — can you pick up the security questionnaire and DPA counterparty review?

I attached a short SOW excerpt for Dedicated (sow_dedicated_excerpt.docx) and a link to our quickstart docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/quickstart-hosted.

Let me know a good time for the infra call — we have openings Wed/Thu PST.

Thanks,
Aditya
